fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for 'Fix Run drivers burn CPU while they wait'. The planner profiled 'rhiza change show' on this repo (2,539 log entries) with RHIZA_CPUPROFILE: about 8 s of CPU, ~5 s reading the log (store.ReadEntries: entry.Decode and canon.Canonicalize of every entry), ~1.5 s in changeset.FoldLog and ~2.3 s in changeNotes; driver poll paths (run_leaves, run_checks, run_review, run_build) read w.model() and w.changeSets(), and ship steps run 'rhiza ship check --settled' every 10 s. Live drivers were near idle while their runs sat in ship wait steps. No owner answered; the arbiter decided (assumed): the change set serves milestone-25, and model reads in drivers, 'rhiza change show', 'rhiza ship check --settled' and 'rhiza apply' go through the existing per-worktree SQLite index (internal/index) instead of reading and folding the whole log; an unchanged stat fingerprint means no model work; writes validate against the index's folded state plus their own entries; only 'rhiza check' and 'rhiza render' read the whole log; no second cache; an idle driver gets a CPU budget test. The planner wrote three leaves: idle driver polls, change show and ship check from the index, and apply from the index. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Plan of the driver CPU fix, autonomous
